name: Jellio Direct
description:
Unofficial build of Jellio+++ (hexSB) that adds a direct play entry
(stream?static=true) next to the HLS entries. Temporary, until direct play
lands in Jellio++ (wujekbogdan/jellio-plus-plus#14).
overview: Unofficial, temporary Jellio build with a direct play entry.

versions.changelog:
- Subtitles on the HLS entries, matched to the file that is playing
- Finds episodes that IMDb numbers differently from Jellyfin (specials, OVAs)
- Episode list option: Cinemeta (IMDb) or Jellyfin (your own seasons, numbering and thumbnails)
- Redesigned settings page

- Max resolution setting for the HLS entries
- Bitrate ceiling down to 2 Mbps
